title: 影响环境的融资
summary: 评估金融机构融资活动对环境的影响及其管理能力，适用于银行、多元化金融等。

sections.title_cn: 引言

blocks.content: This document provides essential information on the components of the Financing Environmental Impact Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how MSCI Sustainability & Climate’s (MSCI S&C’s)1 outputs are determined. Financing Environmental Impact is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Financial institutions are evaluated on the environmental risks of their lending and underwriting activities and their ability to capitalize on opportunities related to green finance.
blocks.content_cn: 本文介绍影响环境的融资关键议题的组成部分，帮助ESG评级使用者了解MSCI可持续发展与气候部门（MSCI S&C）1如何确定其研究输出。影响环境的融资是MSCI ESG评级模型环境支柱下的一项关键议题。对金融机构的评估涵盖其贷款和承销活动的环境风险，以及把握绿色金融相关机遇的能力。

blocks.content: For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to the Data, ratings and scores section of “ESG Ratings Methodology.”
blocks.content_cn: 关于MSCI ESG评级模型的更多细节，请参阅《ESG评级方法论》中"数据、评级和分数"部分。

sections.title_en: Risks associated with this Key Issue
sections.title_cn: 与本关键议题相关的风险

blocks.content: • Increased credit defaults from borrowers that suffer losses related to a range of environmental concerns, including operational disruption, loss of market access, liabilities and asset impairment.
blocks.content_cn: • 借款人因各类环境问题遭受损失，导致信贷违约增加；这些问题包括运营中断、市场准入丧失、负债及资产减值。

blocks.content: • Damage to corporate reputation from financing environmentally harmful projects.
blocks.content_cn: • 为有害环境的项目提供融资所造成的企业声誉损害。

sections.title_en: Financing Environmental Impact Key Issue score
sections.title_cn: 影响环境的融资关键议题得分

blocks.content: The Financing Environmental Impact Key Issue score evaluates the company’s level of exposure to, and management of risks on this Key Issue. The Key Issue score on this Key Issue is based on the Exposure score and the Management score using the formula below. The Exposure score and the Management score are combined such that a higher level of exposure requires a higher level of demonstrated management capability in order to achieve the same overall Key Issue score.

MSCI S&C assigns each indicator a default weight. Indicator weights may be adjusted at the company level to reflect the relevance of the indicator to the company’s business activities. If a company has no exposure to the business activities covered by an indicator, the indicator is assigned a weight of zero.

sections.title_cn: 影响环境的融资管理得分

blocks.content: The Management score evaluates the company’s ability to manage its exposure to risks on this Key Issue. It is based on weighted average of the score associated with each relevant indicator, modified by controversies.
blocks.content_cn: 管理得分评估公司管理该关键议题风险敞口的能力。它基于各相关指标得分的加权平均值计算，并根据争议事件进行调整。

blocks.content: This score is derived from indicators that are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to best practice and 0 corresponding to lack of management. Refer to the Analyzing risk management section of "ESG Ratings Methodology" for additional details. Sources are company disclosures except where otherwise indicated.
blocks.content_cn: 该得分来源于按0—10分评分的指标，10分代表最佳实践，0分代表缺乏管理。更多详情请参阅《ESG评级方法论》的“风险管理分析”部分。除另有说明外，数据来源为公司披露。

sections.title_cn: 影响环境的融资管理体系得分

blocks.content: The Financing Environmental Impact Systems score evaluates the company’s initiatives to establish formal management systems for assessing ESG risks in financing activities. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 影响环境的融资管理体系得分评估公司建立正式管理体系、以评估融资活动中ESG风险的举措。该得分以0—10分表示，10分代表举措有力。

sections.title_en: • Formal management systems to assess ESG risks in financing activities
sections.title_cn: • 评估融资活动中ESG风险的正式管理体系

blocks.content: Definition: Describes the company's management system to assess ESG risks in financing activities. Best practice includes ESG factors systematically embedded in credit assessment, supported by a documented, end-to-end framework that sets out the risk management process.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：描述公司评估融资活动中ESG风险的管理体系。最佳实践包括将ESG因素系统性地纳入信贷评估，并以书面记录的端到端框架明确风险管理流程。

sections.title_en: • Scope of management system to assess ESG risks in financing activities
sections.title_cn: • 评估融资活动中ESG风险的管理体系覆盖范围

blocks.content: Definition: The scope of a company’s formal management systems to assess ESG risks in financing activities. Best practice is to include all credit and investment banking operations.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司用于评估融资活动中ESG风险的正式管理体系的覆盖范围。最佳实践是覆盖全部信贷和投资银行业务。

sections.title_cn: 影响环境的融资整合得分

blocks.content: The Financing Environmental Impact Integration score evaluates the company’s initiatives to integrate ESG considerations into credit risk management, including the role of credit risk teams in due diligence and the presence of clear ESG risk escalation processes. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 影响环境的融资整合得分评估公司将ESG考虑因素纳入信贷风险管理的举措，包括信贷风险团队在尽职调查中的作用，以及是否建立明确的ESG风险升级报告流程。该得分以0—10分表示，10分代表举措有力。

sections.title_en: • Involvement of group credit risk in ESG due diligence
sections.title_cn: • 集团信贷风险管理部门参与ESG尽职调查的情况

blocks.content: Definition: The extent to which the group responsible for credit risk management is directly involved in ESG due diligence.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：负责信贷风险管理的部门直接参与ESG尽职调查的程度。

sections.title_en: • ESG due diligence triggers and risk-escalation process clearly defined
sections.title_cn: • 明确界定ESG尽职调查触发条件及风险升级报告流程

blocks.content: Definition: The level of transparency provided around the escalation process for triggering credit evaluations based on ESG risks. Best practices are to clearly define the ESG risk escalation process, provide details on thresholds for triggering escalation, and provide examples of extra due diligence where necessary.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司对基于ESG风险触发信贷评估的升级报告流程所提供信息的透明度。最佳实践包括清楚界定ESG风险升级报告流程，提供触发升级报告的阈值详情，并在必要时提供额外尽职调查的实例。

sections.title_cn: 影响环境的融资监督得分

blocks.content: The Financing Environmental Impact Oversight score evaluates the company’s initiatives to oversee ESG risk management in financing activities, including accountability for ESG integration and climate-related risk analysis. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 影响环境的融资监督得分评估公司监督融资活动中ESG风险管理的举措，包括ESG整合的责任归属及气候相关风险分析。该得分以0—10分表示，10分代表举措有力。

sections.title_en: • Oversight of ESG risk management in financing activities
sections.title_cn: • 对融资活动中ESG风险管理的监督

blocks.content: Definition: The group or individual that has ultimate responsibility over the integration of ESG considerations in financing and investment activities.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：对在融资和投资活动中纳入ESG考虑因素承担最终责任的部门或个人。

sections.title_cn: • 开展气候相关风险分析

blocks.content: Definition: The company’s initiatives to assess the business risks associated with climate change. Best practice is to integrate climate change risk analysis in financing decisions.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司评估气候变化相关业务风险的举措。最佳实践是将气候变化风险分析纳入融资决策。

sections.title_cn: 影响环境的融资政策得分

blocks.content: The Financing Environmental Impact Policy score evaluates the company’s initiatives to manage environmental risks in financing activities through credit policies that cover key high-impact sectors or
blocks.content_cn: 影响环境的融资政策得分评估公司通过覆盖重大影响行业或主题的信贷政策，管理融资活动中环境风险的举措；相关行业或主题包括

blocks.content: themes, such as agriculture, power utilities, mining, oil and gas and biodiversity. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 农业、电力公用事业、采矿、石油和天然气以及生物多样性。该得分以0—10分表示，10分代表举措有力。

sections.title_cn: • 环境信贷政策得分

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the scope and strength of a financial institution implementing environmental credit policy across five sectors and themes: agriculture, power utilities, mining, oil & gas, biodiversity. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates binding environmental credit policies applied across al five sectors and themes.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估金融机构在农业、电力公用事业、采矿、石油和天然气、生物多样性这五类行业及主题中实施环境信贷政策的范围与力度。该得分以0—10分表示，10分代表具有约束力的环境信贷政策覆盖全部五类行业及主题。

sections.title_cn: ◦ 农业相关信贷政策

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has developed binding or non-binding environmental credit policies, or has adopted voluntary standards, related to agriculture industry financing.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：说明公司是否针对农业融资制定了有约束力或无约束力的环境信贷政策，或采用了自愿性标准。

sections.title_en: ◦ Credit policy related to power utilities
sections.title_cn: ◦ 电力公用事业相关信贷政策

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has developed binding or non-binding environmental credit policies, or has adopted voluntary standards, related to power industry financing.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：说明公司是否针对电力行业融资制定了有约束力或无约束力的环境信贷政策，或采用了自愿性标准。

sections.title_cn: ◦ 采矿相关信贷政策

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has developed binding or non-binding environmental credit policies, or has adopted voluntary standards, related to mining industry financing.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：说明公司是否针对采矿业融资制定了有约束力或无约束力的环境信贷政策，或采用了自愿性标准。

sections.title_en: ◦ Credit policy related to oil and gas
sections.title_cn: ◦ 石油和天然气相关信贷政策

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has developed binding or non-binding environmental credit policies, or has adopted voluntary standards, related to oil and gas industry financing.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：说明公司是否针对石油和天然气行业融资制定了有约束力或无约束力的环境信贷政策，或采用了自愿性标准。

sections.title_cn: ◦ 生物多样性相关信贷政策

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has developed binding or non-binding environmental credit policies, or has adopted voluntary standards, related to biodiversity.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：说明公司是否制定了生物多样性相关的、有约束力或无约束力的环境信贷政策，或采用了自愿性标准。

sections.title_cn: 影响环境的融资机遇得分

blocks.content: The Financing Environmental Impact Opportunities score evaluates the company’s initiatives to expand green financing opportunities through involvement in sustainable securities and the development of sustainability-linked financial products. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 影响环境的融资机遇得分评估公司通过参与可持续证券以及开发可持续发展挂钩金融产品来拓展绿色融资机遇的举措。该得分以0—10分表示，10分代表举措有力。

sections.title_en: • Involvement in green financing and securities
sections.title_cn: • 参与绿色融资和绿色证券的情况

blocks.content: Definition: The extent to which a company invests in green securities or is involved in the structuring of green financing.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司投资绿色证券或参与绿色融资结构设计的程度。

sections.title_cn: • 可持续发展相关金融产品开发

blocks.content: Definition: The extent to which a company has integrated sustainability factors into its financial products, either through pricing mechanisms or other related green financing methods.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司通过定价机制或其他相关绿色融资方式，将可持续发展因素纳入金融产品的程度。

sections.title_cn: 担保债券发行人的处理方式

blocks.content: For institutions that are exclusively refinancing vehicles for multiple loan originators via the issuance of covered bonds, the Financing Environmental Impact Management score is calculated through a “market standard” approach. It is computed as the average Financing Environmental Impact Management score of loan-originating credit institutions with an MSCI ESG Rating in the same domicile country. For refinancing vehicles with a single loan originator, ESG assessments are mapped to the originator.
blocks.content_cn: 对于专门通过发行担保债券为多个贷款发起机构提供再融资的机构，影响环境的融资管理得分采用“市场标准”方法计算，即取同一注册所在国中、具有MSCI ESG评级的贷款发起信贷机构的影响环境的融资管理得分平均值。对于仅对应一家贷款发起机构的再融资载体，其ESG评估结果映射至该贷款发起机构。

blocks.content: The definition of the data point is given below:
blocks.content_cn: 该数据点的定义如下：

sections.title_en: • Financing environmental impact practices score for covered bonds issuers
sections.title_cn: • 担保债券发行人的影响环境的融资实践得分

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates the strength of ESG risk management practices affecting the assets in the cover pool, proxied by the average practices of loan originators in the country of domicile. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong practices.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：反映影响担保资产池内资产的ESG风险管理实践力度，以注册所在国贷款发起机构的平均实践作为代理指标。该得分以0—10分表示，10分代表实践有力。

sections.title_cn: 争议事件

blocks.content: A controversy deduction ranging from 0 to 5 points is subtracted from the overall Management score based on the severity, status, and the company’s role in the controversies facing the company on this Key Issue. The following categories of controversies are used in the assessment.
blocks.content_cn: 根据公司在该关键议题所面临争议事件的严重程度、状态以及公司所扮演的角色，从总体管理得分中扣除0至5分。评估使用以下类别的争议事件。

blocks.content: • Controversial investment controversies.
blocks.content_cn: • 争议性投资相关争议事件。

blocks.content: For more details on how controversies are included in the MSCI ESG Ratings model, refer to the Controversies cases section of “ESG Ratings Methodology.”
blocks.content_cn: 有关争议事件如何纳入MSCI ESG评级模型的更多详情，请参阅《ESG评级方法论》的“争议事件案例”部分。

sections.title_cn: 影响环境的融资风险敞口得分

blocks.content: The Financing Environmental Impact Exposure score evaluates the company’s exposure to risks on this Key Issue. It is based on the Business and Company-Specific Exposure scores. The Business Exposure score and Company-Specific Exposure score are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to the highest risk and 0 corresponding to the lowest risk. Refer to Section: Analyzing Risk Exposure, of “ESG
blocks.content_cn: 影响环境的融资风险敞口得分评估公司在该关键议题下面临的风险敞口，基于业务风险敞口得分和公司特定风险敞口得分计算。两项得分均采用0—10分制，10分表示最高风险，0分表示最低风险。更多详情请参阅《ESG

blocks.content: Ratings Methodology” for additional details. The following formula is used in the Financing Environmental Impact Exposure score calculation:

E X P _ { F E I , i } = B U S _ { F E I , i } ( 1 + 0 . 1 \big ( C O M _ { F E I , i } - 5 \big ) )
$$

sections.title_cn: 业务板块敞口得分

blocks.content: The Business Segment Exposure score of a business segment is based on a mapping of the business segment as disclosed by the company to a corresponding business activity. MSCI S&C uses the Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) system along with industry-specific adjustments to define business activities. The score associated with a business activity is used to calculate a Business Segment Exposure score. Each business activity score is determined by a qualitative assessment of whether a business activity has a core involvement in lending or underwriting activities. A higher involvement will result in a higher Business Segment Exposure score for the business segment.
blocks.content_cn: 业务分部风险敞口得分基于公司披露的业务分部与相应业务活动之间的映射关系。MSCI S&C采用标准行业分类（SIC）体系，并结合行业特定调整来界定业务活动。业务活动对应的得分用于计算业务分部风险敞口得分。每项业务活动的得分通过定性评估该业务活动是否主要涉及贷款或承销业务来确定。参与程度越高，该业务分部的业务分部风险敞口得分越高。
